en: Rent roll, tenants, leases, arrears, deposits and renewals for every owner
Hello {owner_name}, your owner statement for {month} is ready. Net income {net}, paid out {payout}, balance we hold for you {closing}. Message us any time if you have a question.

This agreement starts on {col:agreements.start} between {set:company} (the manager) and {col:agreements.owner_name} (the owner), and runs until {col:agreements.ends}. It renews on the same terms unless either side gives {col:agreements.notice} days' written notice.
